THE CONDITIONS BETWEEN THEM MATTER.

BEHAVIOURAL DESIGN / RESEARCH

Cookstove adoption in South Africa.
QUESTION
What influences the adoption of improved cookstoves among households in Dunoon?
APPROACH
Co-created interventions addressed cooking motivations, assessed through observations and questionnaires.
FINDING
The pilot reported increased LPG and biomass stove ownership, but no significant reduction in paraffin stove ownership.
IMPLICATION
Understanding motivations and everyday cooking practices matters alongside the technology itself.

Research pilot. Maré et al., Sustainability (2023). doi:10.3390/su15065328.
